title: Customer notifications, receipts and communication provenance
workflow: Consume authorized domain event with stable event ID
Resolve recipient preference, lawful purpose and approved localized template
Sanitize payload to minimum needed content for chosen channel
Dispatch through controlled provider without asserting delivery from request submission
Track provider acceptance, actual delivery evidence and failure separately
Link customer receipt to authoritative bank transaction and correction history
invariants: Push or SMS delivery does not prove funds have settled
Do not include passwords, full account numbers or identity scans in notifications
Notification retries cannot trigger financial transactions
Marketing messages require separate lawful preference controls
Sensitive events must not leak across users or institutions
Template and language versions remain audit reconstructable
Provider failure leaves financial source event unchanged
acceptance_tests: Duplicate event yields one logical notification
Provider ACK not treated as delivered
Revoked marketing preference suppresses optional message
Receipt reflects journal adjustment without altering original
independent_gate: Institution communication/privacy policy, event contracts, provider security and delivery/replay tests.
